Q=B*L (RGBA), C=Q*TEXCOORD0 (RGBA tint). R=sample2D(remap,[dot(C.rgb,[.2126,.7152,.0722]),.5]) using sampler15. selectedRGB=(R.a>0 ? R.rgb : C.rgb). Remapalpha only selects replacementRGB; it does not replace outputalpha.

outputRGB=clamp(selectedRGB + Q.a*COLOR0.rimRGB,0,1); outputAlpha=C.a. Rim therefore receives basealpha*lookupalpha before tintalpha. Tintalpha0 does not suppressrim, but lookupalpha0 does suppressrim. Active remap can still supply replacementRGB when lookupalpha0; outputalpha remains0.
